title: Replace version-printing stub with rung-3 pipeline and auditable native comparison link
description:
Dialect @023f5a7 §19.1: "The driver links all bitcode inputs (§19.8), links `bennett-runtimes` and `bennett-arith` bitcode of the link's major M, runs the post-link pipeline (`lto<O3>` by default, or any envelope pipeline of §21.1 the user selects), then runs the plugin on the whole program (NS §3.3)." §17.7: "the materialised device variants, code-generated by the same LLVM major and linked with `bennett-runtimes` and `bennett-arith` (never host libc or libm) under the comparison link of §19.5."

Exact independent driver command:
/home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung3-bennett-driver-306b6e90df85a6b0f59e1e57b04ff7fbcae37ce5/target/debug/bennett-driver --bennett-tier=reversible --bennett-entry=main -bennett-dialect=0.2.10 -bennett-isa=0.8 -bennett-out=/home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung-3/20261101T125019.671846Z/18/driver-probe /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/ladder/rung-3/fixtures/effect-console-r.ll
(and LLVM 23 counterpart). Exit 0, stdout bennett-driver 0.1.0, no launches.json or other pipeline output. Current main only prints the version; no claims about linking the blocked musl corpus are made.

Fixed means: implement §19.1/19.2 whole-program pipeline, major-matched libraries and R launch, runtime/native-comparison link and metadata; no silent success on ignored options. Provide argc/argv/envp reply integration. Agree consumer glue with ladder/rung-3 (native-comparison.json auditable link_argv or an equivalent adapter, and argv reply file); these filenames/CLI adapter flags are not spec mandates. Native link must consume the actual materialised device module and runtimes/arith, no host libc/libm. Handle ISA-0.8 BD-B-ISA7 explicitly; do not change the pinned gate to 0.9 silently. Estimated size large (960 minutes).

Evidence: /home/tobias/Projects/bennett-workspace/bennett-conformance/.tmp/rung-3/20261101T125019.671846Z (report.json, exact argv and per-command stdout/stderr). North Star §8 rung 3 remains full ordinary musl printf hello-world, R console, reset and deterministic saved-tape replay; no freestanding replacement, host-libc comparison or fake marker definition is acceptable. These are prerequisites, not downstream corpus verdicts.
